John Danaher - Ageless Jiu Jitsu - Compl.overview: John Danaher's no-gi bottom game for older or less athletic grapplers, eight volumes. Volume 1 builds a theory of how older and less athletic people should play from the bottom. Volume 2 covers the first skill they need (not getting stuck under pins). Volume 3 builds an offensive bottom game. Volume 4 covers getting to half guard from a neutral position. Volume 5 covers the first steps to winning from bottom half guard. Volume 6 covers the 2-on-1 series from bottom half. Volume 7 covers the bottom submission game. Volume 8 is a special study of hiza gatame (a knee-based arm lock).
John Danaher - Ageless Jiu Jitsu - Compl.for: Older or less athletic no-gi grapplers.
key: Theory of a low-athleticism bottom game
Getting to and winning from half guard

John Danaher - Ageless Jiu Jitsu - Compl.overview: John Danaher's no-gi top game for older or less athletic grapplers, eight volumes, built around half guard as the natural place to pass from. Volume 1 covers the half guard top game. Volume 2 covers getting to chest-to-chest position. Volume 3 covers winning the upper body battle in half guard. Volume 4 covers winning the lower body battle. Volume 5 covers pinning, which favours older players. Volumes 6 to 8 are special studies of three low-risk finishes: the americana, the kimura and kata gatame (arm triangle). The course also uses the over-under, double under, knee cut and long step passes.
John Danaher - Ageless Jiu Jitsu - Compl.for: Older or less athletic no-gi grapplers.

John Danaher - collection 480p/Enter the.overview: John Danaher's back attack system, the one his Death Squad used to dominate no-gi, eight volumes. Volume 1 is the system overview. Volume 2 covers the neutrality and primacy principles. Volume 3 covers attacking from the underarm side (double straight direct grip and others). Volume 4 covers the one-handed strangle and technical notes on the rear naked choke. Volume 5 introduces the auxiliary systems (the rear triangle). Volume 6 covers leg attacks and arm attacks (hammer lock) from the back. Volume 7 covers establishing hooks and rear mount. Volume 8 covers near-side entries to the back.
John Danaher - collection 480p/Enter the.for: No-gi grapplers who want a systematic back attack game.
key: Rear naked choke and one-handed strangles
